tools.name: get_regime
tools.description: Only the current SPX dealer regime label and its confidence, a small read for checking whether conditions have changed; no walls, gamma flip, net GEX or strike detail. Realtime with an API key; without a key this serves a delayed preview.

tools.name: list_history_dates
tools.description: Free catalog of available historical SPX market-structure replay dates. No API key required; actual replay datasets are paid.

tools.name: get_day
tools.description: The full market-structure history of one past trading day, the larger replay: the intraday timeline (walls, gamma flip, net GEX, regime, spot) plus a day summary. One replay date (YYYY-MM-DD) per call. Data only -- not investment advice or a trade recommendation.

tools.name: get_regime_segments
tools.description: Only how the dealer regime changed during one past trading day, the compact replay: a list of regime segments with their start and end times; no walls, gamma flip, net GEX or spot. One replay date (YYYY-MM-DD) per call.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: subscribe_event · Private data: get_market_structure, get_regime, list_history_dates, create_guest_key, get_credit_balance · Public sink: subscribe_event · Destructive: unsubscribe_event.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: subscribe_event · Private data: get_market_structure, get_regime, list_history_dates, create_guest_key, get_credit_balance · Public sink: subscribe_event · Destructive: unsubscribe_event

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
